_: Engine deck spec: everything the bench cannot measure, declared here with its source. `streamline engine fit projects/icarus/engine/spec.json` runs the fits over bench_bags and writes engine_deck.json. NO BENCH THRUST EXISTS (no load cell) — thrust is a power-law prior anchored at the datasheet; fuel flow and spool dynamics are fitted from the Nov/Oct 2025 bags. See PROVENANCE.md.

datasheet._: H20PRO Engine USER MANUAL rev 10 EN, section 2.4 Operational limits (15 degC, 1013 hPa)

thrust_model._: T = 200 N * (N/123000)^2. Exponent 2 is the classical rotor-speed scaling; small turbojets measure 2-3 in the upper band. Replace with kind='measured' the day a load cell run exists.

fuel.type: Jet A-1 / kerosene + 5% turbine oil (manual sec 2.3)
fuel._: capacity_kg = the Fusion 'Weight Estimates CAD' tankage (main 3.32 L + hopper 0.59 L = 3.91 L, user-confirmed 2026-08-18) x 0.80 kg/L kerosene-oil mix. Usable-fuel margin (unusable volume, expansion) not yet applied.

thrust_line._: H20PRO stack geom bbox centre in icarus-B, FRD from the datum; axis along +x (thrust forward)

notes: Static bench runs of the Icarus H20PRO logged over CAN by machpilot (rosbag2 -> CSV). Primary run 2025-11-16 15:25 (full 0-100% throttle staircase to 117.8 kRPM, up and down); 2025-10-26 (6-plateau staircase to 80 kRPM); 2025-11-16 14:49 (single ramp, transient only); 2025-03-01 15:33 (one ~60 s light, idle-region anchor). ECU fuel_flow is VOLUMETRIC mL/min computed from pump revolutions and uncalibrated (manual sec 8.6) — the bench reads ~770 mL/min at 117 kRPM vs the datasheet's ~675 mL/min-equivalent at 200 N; both retained, the datasheet point pulls the fit. Ambient: bench box pressure ~945 hPa, 17-20 degC (Blacksburg VA, ~640 m).
